Safe and Defensive Autonomous Driving Workshop on ECCV 2026

Building autonomous systems that proactively avoid latent hazards, reason under uncertainty, and deliver trustworthy defensive behavior.

Call for Papers View Program

Conference

ECCV 2026

  • Dates September 8–12, 2026
  • Venue Malmö, Sweden

About

SDAD (Safe and Defensive Autonomous Driving) is an ECCV 2026 full-day workshop in Malmö. We organize around three core problems:

  1. What dangers appear in driving scenes—including latent hazards that are difficult to observe?
  2. How can autonomous vehicles learn defensive driving under uncertainty and long-tail situations?
  3. How can we evaluate defensive driving behaviors beyond trajectory-centric benchmarks?

Call for Papers

We invite non-archival submissions on defensive driving, latent hazards, learning under uncertainty, and evaluation beyond trajectory-centric benchmarks. Reviews run on OpenReview; accepted work is presented as posters, with spotlight and best-paper selections.

Submission deadline: July 8, 2026
